Note: They might not be valide anymore but give a try ! ⬆️ Subscription Ragnarok Zero:Global is a subscription based model game. This is the minimum requirement to log in and play on one account. As multiple accounts are permitted, you will, however, need to pay for X subscriptions for X accounts. Note that from the launch on the 18th of August to the end of 2026, 3-day free trial accounts can be used to test the game ! ⬆️ New User Interface There’s a new graphical interface that looks a bit more modern: But if you are too nostalgic you can also go for the very old UI experience: Esc > Game Settings > By default, the shortcuts have also been revised and no longer use a key combination involving the ALT key. To revert to this, you can enable it as follows: ⬆️ Settings Plenty of settings are available and you are free to play with them to get the best Ragnarok experience you're looking for: One that I will recommend to anyone is the additional zoom out cells: A lot of /commands are available also and feel free to check them all with /help or /h in the chat. Most of them are available through the settings interface. Don't forget the /nc or /ns and also /quake which can be crucial for your gameplay! I personall y also use /stateinfo to see the buffs description and timers. I also like to see the former display name using /showname. Second Skills Bar You can have a second skill bar mapped with the exact same key binds or different ones and you can alternate between the two with just a click: First Skill Bar Second Skill Bar Quite handy especially for classes with a lot of spells and with builds that are or might be played differently from a content to another (i.e: PvM and PvP/WoE). ⬆️ Casting Information You can find more information a spell with casting and cooldown time using the small yellowed clock at the top right corner of a skill description ! ⬆️ Tip Box A nice things to keep in mind is also the Tip Box especially to easily find what headgear can be crafted: ⬆️ Item Sale Lock Don’t worry about selling a valuable item to the tool dealer any more, you can lock an item to prevent it from appearing in the list of items for sale. Head to the Favorites window in your inventory (fourth category): ⬆️ Navigation Use the navigation to find NPCs and monsters, as well as the (in theory) best route to get there. All you have to do is follow the arrows down the floor. To get there, click after using “Move” to travel there manually, or pay for the service using various items, which will teleport you directly to the selected map: Possible items: Zelstar (available in the Cash Shop), World Ticket, or usin g the dew through the Essential Care Package . ⬆️ World Map This map of the Ragnarok world gives you an overview from the Taiwanese server, showing the main monsters and the level of each zone: You can also use the world map to teleport yourself similarly to the Navigation Menu. ⬆️ RO Factory Plenty of customisation is available for fine tuning foot steps . RO Factory ⬆️ Get Poring Get Poring From this application, where you can take care of special porings. When it reaches his final form, you can use a Valhalla Pass and bring it to the server. Plenty of customisation is available for fine tuning foot steps, find some examples below : Note that for now you can only import their final stage. ⬆️ Channels Each map is divided into several zones: the "original" zone, followed by zones or channels A, B, C and D. Depending on the number of players in these zones, you can decide to switch between them. This device is available on every map near a warp. Important note: When you are in one of these zones, all warps are disabled. To return to the ‘global’ or shared zone, you must select ‘current’ as shown below; as Zone A was previously selected, it does not appear in the list of suggestions. Once you have been teleported to the current/global channel, the warps will be available again. Hidden World In addition to the five zones, including the so-called ‘current’ zone, there are also two PvP zones, Y and Z, which can be accessed via the NPC who looks like a seated Novice: Important note: unlike the global zones A, B, C and D, you cannot teleport once you are inside these PvP zones. The benefits of these PvP zones are: Increased number of monsters More respawn 10% EXP boost (can be activated)* 10% drop rate boost (can be activated)* To get there, you’ll need a key, which can be obtained via the Cash Shop and is valid for your character; it cannot be placed in storage: * Once the box has been opened, you can use the item as an activatable boost that increases experience and drop rates by 10% for 12 hours. To leave this area, simply return to the character selection screen, which will take you straight to your save point when you return to the game. Note: There is a daily reset of the PvP maps at 2.00 am (CEST); your character will then be teleported to one of the non-PvP areas and will continue hunting as before, but without the 10% EXP/drop bonus. ⬆️ Achievements Rewards based on challenges you’ve completed and those still to come are available in the game; these often take the form of Increase Agi or Blessing buffs, but may also include cosmetic titles or items: Simply complete the challenges and then click the “Claim Reward” button to receive your rewards. On most maps, there is a treasure; you can search for it and earn Zenys after claiming your reward from this menu. ⬆️ Login First of all, if you struggle to log into your account, please do check that you are not having any capital letters in your email as this is case sensitive (and capital letters are useless in emails) . It has been a common mistake for people having connection issues on Beta Tests ! First Steps The start is very different from what you might have experienced on other servers, and the directions are fairly clear. You just need to follow the arrows to go from one NPC to another and do what they ask. You won’t have to grind job levels to change class; you’ll pick them up as you go through the tutorial quest. Do remember to allocate your skill points, though, or you’ll get stuck and the NPC won’t let you change class! Next, all you need to do is go upstairs and head to the room with the name of the class you want to play. There’s no need for a job-change quest like in the old days. Congratulation, first steps completed ! You can now speak back to Spraki and continue with the Main Quest . ⬆️ Daily Login Everytime you login to your account this pop-up will appear and you can click on the daily reward and this will be sent to you by RODEX. Note: If you are playing more than 24h, keep it mind to visit it because it won't appear automatically Attendance NPC When you talk to this NPC a countdown of one hour is starting, visit this NPC after one hour to collect the reward. This can be done everyday per character. This NPC is located in almost every town of the game and often next to the Kafra. Early Game Different levelling spots are available based on your class choice. Some classes are more comfortable in some spots than in others. See below for some ideas: Mage/Range: Flora, Parasite, Grove, Steel Chonchon… Melee: There are two types: those that can use AoE and those that can’t: Non-AoE: Spore, Bigfoot, Coco, Thara, Sohee, Orc Warrior/Lady, Argiope… AoE: Poison Spore, Wolf, Goblin… Important note: Experience on Ragnarok Zero:Global does not appear to be scaled with level as expected in Renewal; in other words, a monster will always grant the same amount of experience regardless of your level, so certain ranged classes or even groups can take full advantage of this. Route Planner You can use tools like the Route Planner available on Midgard Hub by Ryan. Any monster can be added to Planner. You can share the planner with other or even save it. Have a try ! ⬆️ Leveling by Class Mage As you can reset your stats and skills for free up to level 40, you can simply start off in melee mode right from the start until you get Earth Spike to level 1. Head to Culvert and follow the path to get Fire Bolt to level 10. Reset your stats and max out INT. Head for Ant Hell, the aim being to reach level 20 - 30 and be able to one-shot the Wolves. Use the lowest possible level with Fire Bolt. Once you’re comfortable, you can have a go at the Steel Chonchons with Earth Spike level 5. Other possibilities, among many others no doubt, include the Parasites, the Groves, the Argiopes… Note that auto-hunt won’t be your friend on these final maps. My experience is the following during the second OBT (using Free Kafra Point): Get 2 level jobs on Spore, get Fire Bolt level 2 and stay on Spore until Earth Spike is 5 then move to Steel Chonchon and stay there until the level 50 base 50 job. Very chill… 🙂 Thief Culvert / (Poison) Spore > Bigfoot > Thara Frog / Coco > Orc Warrior/Lady Your strength is your dodging, your weakness is certainly no AoE spells. You’ll have to bash the monsters one by one. Swordman Culvert / (Poison) Spore > Bigfoot > Thara Frog / Coco > Orc Warrior/Lady Your strength, your tankiness. You’ll have to bash the monsters one by one; Bash is your best friend, especially with the stun passive. Alternatives using Magnum Break may be worth considering. Archer Culvert / (Poison) Spore > Bigfoot > Thara Frog / Coco > Orc Warrior/Lady Just like the Thief/Swordman, except that you’re a ranged class, which gives you a few alternatives such as Flora or Parasites. There might be a way to make use of Arrow Shower and MTs… it’s up to you to try it out 👍 Merchant Culvert / (Poison) Spore > Bigfoot > Thara Frog / Coco > Orc Warrior/Lady > Goblin With plenty of SP, Cart Revolution can be a formidable ally, especially towards the end of levelling, when it starts to take much longer. Acolyte As you can reset your stats (and skills) for free up to level 40, don’t worry too much about it – in the early game, you can simply go for a melee build. The Acolyte will follow much the same path as the other melee classes. As the heal bomb is rather poor, I’d advise going for a battle build before level 40; after that, you’ll need to decide on your future path and probably find a duo or a group if you’re going down the support route. ⬆️ Group Leveling A group experience bonus is available and, according to my latest tests , it works as follows: This means that a team, or a group where everyone plays their part (no slacker...), will perform relatively better than if you’re playing solo; the same applies to auto-hunting if everyone manages to get by on their own. Depending on the group’s composition and provided auto-hunt is not used, a group of 10-12 players can easily target leveling areas that are significantly tougher than those they would face whilst soloing or using auto-hunt. Examples: When soloing, certain classes will head to the Orcs around levels 30-35; it is highly likely that a good group could venture there as early as level 25. A duo or trio consisting of a mobber, a damage dealer (DD) and a support character is also very effective, depending on the zone they’re in. If you’re just a tad short of HIT to maintain consistent damage output, there’s nothing better than a duo with an Acolyte for a Blessing and Increase Agi. If the support character has Pneuma, a zone like the Parasites will be a piece of cake. ⬆️ Adventurer Agency This is the tab where you can find a leveling group ! You can register your group and automatically recruit new players; to do so, simply open the Adventurers Agency as follows: As a leader, you can therefore promote your group – just make sure you specify the area and channel where your team is based. If a member leaves the group, the shared experience will be reset and become individual; it’s up to you to manually set it back to shared, otherwise the group members who aren’t AFK are bound to complain. If you’re looking for a group, you can click on one; if it isn’t full, you’ll be added to it just a few seconds after clicking “Join Party”: ⬆️ Affixes Affixes are an essential part of the game; getting the piece of equipment with the best affixes for your class is the way to go in Zero. The list of affixes is available here . When an item with one or more affixes drops to the ground, it will be surrounded by a coloured halo corresponding to the number of affixes: blue for 1 yellow for 2 purple for 3 green for 4 (to be checked) Red for 5 (to be checked) Notes: Max HP is often prioritised to avoid dying too early HIT and FLEE are quite important for melee classes Max SP for classes that use skills Or Variable Casting Time for casters (mages and acolytes) Find below some Armors and Weapons dropped by specific monsters for the early game: ⬆️ Cash Shop Probably one of the lightest CS ever on Ragnarok (since CS exists...) nonetheless it is present even if we are running a subscription based model... and of course it gives some advantages: Exp/Drop Boosts Consummables Stats Boosts, HP/SP Regen Potions, Life Insurance, Death Penalty Reduction, Token... Gym Passes Permanent mount (but you cannot attack when mounted, it gives movement speed) Ores (7+ Refines Boxes) QoL items to be paid weekly or monthly (Portable Kafra/Tool Dealer) Hidden World Key to access Y and Z PvP channels Costumes (A lot...) Beginner Weapons/Armors The only way to consume it is to load credits aka Kafra Points through the Top-up services. ⬆️ Main Quest Throughout your adventure on Ragnarok Zero:Global, there’s a main quest (MQ) available which offers a change from the XP grind and also allows you to gain experience. Most of these are still ‘FedEx’-style quests, but they do provide a welcome break. There are level requirements, and you won’t be able to complete everything in one go (for example, level 20, level 40, etc.). The main quest continues as new patches are released. Note: During the open beta, doing all the main quest was representing 4 4 % at level 49. More details to come after the opening. ⬆️ Auto Hunt This is a feature that allows your character to hunt autonomously based on a whole host of parameters, which I won’t go into here but there is a very very nice guide made by Lys please have a look to it ! Slacker's Survival Guide by Lys Once auto-hunt has been set up, simply click on the twin swords so that they turn blue, indicating that auto-hunt is activated. Your character will then begin to explore the map according to your settings The Monsters section is reset between each map change, so if you decide to exclude any monsters, you’ll need to redo that selection only. You can configure a key to enable or disable the auto-hunt in the Game Settings. Auto Pot (AP) To be used during manual hunting; the settings for this auto-pot remain the same as those set in auto-hunt. Very useful when managing your HP/SP isn’t a priority. You can assign a key to toggle the mode on and off. Same as before, when activated the logo turns blue. ⬆️ Memorial Dungeon These are daily activities that you can make as a team and solo later. The nicest thing, I discovered was the fact that even if you disconnect or leave the instance for any reason, you can still enter it again as long as the instance is still open . Poring Village /navi pront_fild05 146/235 You’ll be battling waves of Porings, each ending with a boss; defeat all three bosses and you’ll receive your daily reward. Nothing really fancy and available starting level 30+. Leave the instance and destroy it to loot the chest: Rewards One for each day of the week and a box for the weekend days: Monday: Poring Jello Fragment Tuesday: Poporing Jello Fragment Wednesday: Drop Jello Fragment Thursday: Deviling Jello Fragment Friday: Angeling Jello Fragment Saturday/Sunday: Jellopy Fragment Box Why farming them? It will required for the End Game Sets later so I recommend everyone to farm them daily as much as you can ! /navi prt_in 118/30 where j ello fragments can be turned into Jellostones, 5 for 1: The stone will be ready in 3 days but if you can't wait, you can use 5 Zelstars to get the stone directly (which can be very costly). Note: You can do it on one character at a time but several of your characters can do it. More information can be found on this website but so far it is not available on the server: https://old.criatura-academy.com/memorial-dungeons/equipment-crafting/ Lower Enchantment /navi prt_fild05 168/237 You can enchant the Green Onion or the Carrot with a 70% Success Rate and requires: 50 Jellopy 20K Zenys You could get one of the following enchants: +1 in one of the 6 stats SP+10 or 25 or 50 HP+100 or 200 Note that you can try to retry the enchant but it cost 20K Zenys to remove the previous enchant with the same risk of failure. ⬆️ MvP Raid Several areas will hold MvP Raids such as Culvert with Golden Thief Bug (aka GTB) or Moon Light Flower and more to come in the future. For GTB, from the last floor, take the Red warp for the non-PvP zone: The MvP is in these rooms (if spawned) and currently, the player killing the MVP is rewarded with the following: Note that when the MvP died on our first try, 2 more boxes dropped on the floor. A multitude of fragments dropped on the floor all over the map and are probably lootable by anyone. The fragments can then be exchanged at the Raid Manager, Yakt standing in the Eden HQ. There is a daily quest and I advise anyone to participate in the PvE MvP Raids as much as you can ! ⬆️ Mission Board Apart from the Main Quest (MQ), I wouldn’t recommend doing the side quests, as they involve relatively interesting tasks but offer rewards that are only average at best (HP/SP potions). Having say that... If you don’t know what path to follow it is still a good way to start to walk on the different maps of the game. The consumables are overall good. ⬆️ Market Place Unlike many official servers, where the player shops are directly in Prontera or even Alberta (ah, the good old days ❤️), a dedicated area is available and can be accessed from the Kafra in Prontera: The area is divided into four zones, and you can travel quickly from one to another if you wish: The Kafra, a Blacksmith’s forge and a Tool Dealer are available, notably right in the center. This first step will allow you to return to Prontera. You can therefore set up a Vending or Buying post, whether or not you are a merchant class : You can search for specific item using the Vending Search Scroll (1) or the Deluxe Vending Search Scroll (2) : The research using these catalogs are care sensitive to be careful 😙 The only difference between the regular and deluxe catalogs are about finding shops. The latest one, the deluxe version, allows you to instantly buy the item without moving while using the regular one you will have find it yourself: Double click on the Shop Name, a white cross will appear on the minimap to give you a rough idea of the location and the shop will be highlighted. You can keep the catalog opened while walking and up to 5 searches can be done before to require another one. It is indeed possible to complete a quest that allows you to act as a seller or buyer whilst offline or whilst playing your character. Quest Once a week per character, you can complete the quest that allows you to buy or sell; after that, you’ll need to pay 500k to enjoy this privilege more often than once a week. /navi alberta_in 19/19 ⬆️ NPCs "Hub" Many of the NPCs listed below can be accessed via this NPC, who can be found in various towns but always looks the sam e. /navi payon 164/156 /navi prontera 138 / 125 This NPC teleports you to a dedicated map with a few NPCs, I am calling it the NPC "Hub": The blacksmith will be skipped here as he has a dedicated chapter. Reset Skills/Stats Up to and including level 40, you can reset your stats and skills for free. Above level 40, if you want to reset either of these, it will cost you 1 Zelstar per additional level: if you are level 80, you will need 40 Zelstars. Note that several free resets should come to the server at major patches... could be the right time to test out things ! Exceptional Reset From time to time a cat will appear in Payon allowing you unlimited free stats/skill resets /navi payon 164/49 Stylist You can change your hairstyle, your hair colour and the colour of your clothes. Note that the colour of your clothes also affects your mount. Coupons are available in the Cash Shop: Gym Pass When you buy Gym Passes, you can activate them once you’ve opened them and spoken to this NPC as many times as necessary. A total of 10 Gym Passes can be used per character, and these are available in the Cash Shop: Costumes Almost all monsters can drop costumes and these drops are announced via a server-wide broadcast; the drop rates seem to be similar to those for cards. Binding Removal Costumes are linked to your account but can be unlinked using an item from the Cash Shop if you wish to trade or sell them to other players: Enchanter (Box) You can buy a box of enchantments for 10K Zenys: You can then place 5 outfits in it and receive a random gem that can be used to enchant an outfit. Enchantments Then all you need to do is use the stone and select the costume, also note that enchantments can be combined to cancel out certain penalties: ⬆️ Forge Available in the new area, the NPC "Hub", but also at the usual locations such as Prontera and Payon. This NPC also allows you to repair items, purchase certain smithing components and process rough materials. There’s no ‘safe refine’ from 0 to +4, so there’s bound to be some breakage! © Elvyl ⬆️ Cheese Seller For classes that require the use of skills and therefore use up quite a lot of SP, there’s a Cheese vendor in Prontera, for example, so don’t hesitate to pop in if you’ve got the cash! /navi prontera 74/133 ⬆️ Bank A bank is available and is shared by all users on your account; simply click through the menus or press CTRL+B to display it. It's really something that I have been missing a lot on my last decade... ⬆️ Inn Exp Boost Each inn has its own opening hours; if you rest at the inn during the relevant times, you will receive a +10% EXP bonus for 30 minutes. Note: The server times are in UTC, so add 2 hours in summer and 1 hour in winter. Example: 14:00 UTC is 16:00 CEST, otherwise it is 15:00 CET. This bonus cannot be combined with the below potion : ⬆️ Equipment Stats You can view a summary of the bonuses provided by your equipment: I don't know you, but I feel nice having this feature after decades counting things every single time when theorycrafting my builds! ⬆️ Clan If you don’t have a guild, while I strongly recommend to look for one, you can also register to a clan: /navi prt_in 37/112 The buff they provide is nice for the early game so do not hesitate. Keep it mind that if you are part of a clan, you cannot be part of a guild. You will first need to leave the clan and to do so, please visit the Clan Master you initially talked to. ⬆️ Guild I strongly encourage anyone to join a guild because a lot of content is enjoyable and easier in small to high guilds such as: Memorial Dungeons Leveling Party with EXP songs MvP Raids PvP content GvG content (War of Emperium) Do visit the official Discord section to check the guilds that are recruiting, in your mother tongue or internationally ! Within a guild you can have up to 75 other members than you. Note s: E mblem can be animated 🎉 You can change the Guild Leader once every 24 hours Leveling /navi prt_in 37/112 On Zero, the guild leveling is made through quests completed by the members depending on their level. Members can complete daily quest and receive: Organization's Unity (Copper/Silver/...). This is currently the only way to grind the guild levels as the previous system by taxing members is removed. Higher rewards will be obtained at higher levels such as: The amount of EXP required per level is as follow: Guild Exp Table ⬆️ Qpets & Enchantments There is a quest in Izlude for Pet Taming: /navi iz_ac01 45/78 You can try to capture a Little Poring and receive taming items. Taming Ring You can attach a Qpet to an accessory that provides bonus stats. To do this, you’ll need a Taming Ring, which can be equipped in the right-hand slot and is available for 50K Zenys. /navi payon 175/131 /navi izlude_in 72/97 For level two, you’ll need another egg, but the success rate is only 50%: © Lys Enchantements List © Elvyl ⬆️ Key Bind Switch You can assign a key or key combination to switch between two sets of gear. This is very effective in mobbing/DD roles, or simply in different parts of the game, such as in instances or PvP/WoE, for example! This action can be performed every 10 seconds. ⬆️ Earn Zenys First tip: make sure you have a Merchant with Discount and Overcharge set to 10 on your account; this will allow them to take items directly from the Kafra and sell them at a good price. Bear in mind that some items will likely be in high demand among players, and it’ll be more profitable to sell them to players rather than to NPCs. Lots of monsters drop Fly Wings ; you’ll probably end up with more than you need, but they sell very, very well to NPCs. As for loot in general, don’t hesitate to pick everything up, many items are very useful. Selling them to NPCs or other players will allow you to afford purchases such as HP/SP consumables or ammunition. Strawberries even sold at the NPC is a great source of income and it's easy to get on Snakes even at the lowest levels. While hunting snakes, what I like is that they also drop Red Herbs allowing your character to keep up with high HP very easily... Note: Strawberries are equivalent to 6 Cheeses, check what is working for you ! Oridecon/Elunium ores (whether refined or not) are sure to be an essential resource, particularly as there’s no ‘safe refine’ option, so you’re going to need a looooooot of them🎉. If you don’t need gear with certain affixes, someone else surely does! It’s up to you to strike the right balance with the other gear already on the market. Crafts for Alchemists are also worth looking into: Assassins will have/have Enchant Deadly Poison (EDP); do remember to keep this to hand – it might come in handy after some patches: A few more items for crafting weapons with Blacksmiths specialising in forging: ⬆️ Roadmap The roadmap announced initially between the second OBT and the server launch can be find here: Roadmap ⬆️ Timeline This is what the Taiwanese Zero server received as patching for a year or so. Timeline ⬆️ Content Creator New Category On Twitch (and Youtube in the future), Ragnarok Zero: Global is having its own category and most of the streamers will be under this category and not the regular Ragnarok Online. Please do miss us ! ⬆️ Ragnarok Content Creator Program I am part of the 1st gen of the RHCP ! Yay ! It certainly means a lot of nice things on our respective platforms ! Twitch, Youtube, Facebook... Plenty of customisation is available for fine tuning foot steps, find some examples below : Note that for now you can only import their final stage. ⬆️ Channels Each map is divided into several zones: the "original" zone, followed by zones or channels A, B, C and D. Depending on the number of players in these zones, you can decide to switch between them. This device is available on every map near a warp. Important note: When you are in one of these zones, all warps are disabled. To return to the ‘global’ or shared zone, you must select ‘current’ as shown below; as Zone A was previously selected, it does not appear in the list of suggestions. Once you have been teleported to the current/global channel, the warps will be available again. Hidden World In addition to the five zones, including the so-called ‘current’ zone, there are also two PvP zones, Y and Z, which can be accessed via the NPC who looks like a seated Novice: Important note: unlike the global zones A, B, C and D, you cannot teleport once you are inside these PvP zones. The benefits of these PvP zones are: Increased number of monsters More respawn 10% EXP boost (can be activated)* 10% drop rate boost (can be activated)* To get there, you’ll need a key, which can be obtained via the Cash Shop and is valid for your character; it cannot be placed in storage: * Once the box has been opened, you can use the item as an activatable boost that increases experience and drop rates by 10% for 12 hours. To leave this area, simply return to the character selection screen, which will take you straight to your save point when you return to the game. Note: There is a daily reset of the PvP maps at 2.00 am (CEST); your character will then be teleported to one of the non-PvP areas and will continue hunting as before, but without the 10% EXP/drop bonus. ⬆️ Achievements Rewards based on challenges you’ve completed and those still to come are available in the game; these often take the form of Increase Agi or Blessing buffs, but may also include cosmetic titles or items: Simply complete the challenges and then click the “Claim Reward” button to receive your rewards. On most maps, there is a treasure; you can search for it and earn Zenys after claiming your reward from this menu. ⬆️ Login First of all, if you struggle to log into your account, please do check that you are not having any capital letters in your email as this is case sensitive (and capital letters are useless in emails) . It has been a common mistake for people having connection issues on Beta Tests ! First Steps The start is very different from what you might have experienced on other servers, and the directions are fairly clear. You just need to follow the arrows to go from one NPC to another and do what they ask. You won’t have to grind job levels to change class; you’ll pick them up as you go through the tutorial quest. Do remember to allocate your skill points, though, or you’ll get stuck and the NPC won’t let you change class! Next, all you need to do is go upstairs and head to the room with the name of the class you want to play. There’s no need for a job-change quest like in the old days. Congratulation, first steps completed ! You can now speak back to Spraki and continue with the Main Quest . ⬆️ Daily Login Everytime you login to your account this pop-up will appear and you can click on the daily reward and this will be sent to you by RODEX. Note: If you are playing more than 24h, keep it mind to visit it because it won't appear automatically Attendance NPC When you talk to this NPC a countdown of one hour is starting, visit this NPC after one hour to collect the reward. This can be done everyday per character. This NPC is located in almost every town of the game and often next to the Kafra. Early Game Different levelling spots are available based on your class choice. Some classes are more comfortable in some spots than in others. See below for some ideas: Mage/Range: Flora, Parasite, Grove, Steel Chonchon… Melee: There are two types: those that can use AoE and those that can’t: Non-AoE: Spore, Bigfoot, Coco, Thara, Sohee, Orc Warrior/Lady, Argiope… AoE: Poison Spore, Wolf, Goblin… Important note: Experience on Ragnarok Zero:Global does not appear to be scaled with level as expected in Renewal; in other words, a monster will always grant the same amount of experience regardless of your level, so certain ranged classes or even groups can take full advantage of this. Route Planner You can use tools like the Route Planner available on Midgard Hub by Ryan. Any monster can be added to Planner. You can share the planner with other or even save it. Have a try ! ⬆️ Leveling by Class Mage As you can reset your stats and skills for free up to level 40, you can simply start off in melee mode right from the start until you get Earth Spike to level 1. Head to Culvert and follow the path to get Fire Bolt to level 10. Reset your stats and max out INT. Head for Ant Hell, the aim being to reach level 20 - 30 and be able to one-shot the Wolves. Use the lowest possible level with Fire Bolt. Once you’re comfortable, you can have a go at the Steel Chonchons with Earth Spike level 5. Other possibilities, among many others no doubt, include the Parasites, the Groves, the Argiopes… Note that auto-hunt won’t be your friend on these final maps. My experience is the following during the second OBT (using Free Kafra Point): Get 2 level jobs on Spore, get Fire Bolt level 2 and stay on Spore until Earth Spike is 5 then move to Steel Chonchon and stay there until the level 50 base 50 job. Very chill… 🙂 Thief Culvert / (Poison) Spore > Bigfoot > Thara Frog / Coco > Orc Warrior/Lady Your strength is your dodging, your weakness is certainly no AoE spells. You’ll have to bash the monsters one by one. Swordman Culvert / (Poison) Spore > Bigfoot > Thara Frog / Coco > Orc Warrior/Lady Your strength, your tankiness. You’ll have to bash the monsters one by one; Bash is your best friend, especially with the stun passive. Alternatives using Magnum Break may be worth considering. Archer Culvert / (Poison) Spore > Bigfoot > Thara Frog / Coco > Orc Warrior/Lady Just like the Thief/Swordman, except that you’re a ranged class, which gives you a few alternatives such as Flora or Parasites. There might be a way to make use of Arrow Shower and MTs… it’s up to you to try it out 👍 Merchant Culvert / (Poison) Spore > Bigfoot > Thara Frog / Coco > Orc Warrior/Lady > Goblin With plenty of SP, Cart Revolution can be a formidable ally, especially towards the end of levelling, when it starts to take much longer. Acolyte As you can reset your stats (and skills) for free up to level 40, don’t worry too much about it – in the early game, you can simply go for a melee build. The Acolyte will follow much the same path as the other melee classes. As the heal bomb is rather poor, I’d advise going for a battle build before level 40; after that, you’ll need to decide on your future path and probably find a duo or a group if you’re going down the support route. ⬆️ Group Leveling A group experience bonus is available and, according to my latest tests , it works as follows: This means that a team, or a group where everyone plays their part (no slacker...), will perform relatively better than if you’re playing solo; the same applies to auto-hunting if everyone manages to get by on their own. Depending on the group’s composition and provided auto-hunt is not used, a group of 10-12 players can easily target leveling areas that are significantly tougher than those they would face whilst soloing or using auto-hunt. Examples: When soloing, certain classes will head to the Orcs around levels 30-35; it is highly likely that a good group could venture there as early as level 25. A duo or trio consisting of a mobber, a damage dealer (DD) and a support character is also very effective, depending on the zone they’re in. If you’re just a tad short of HIT to maintain consistent damage output, there’s nothing better than a duo with an Acolyte for a Blessing and Increase Agi. If the support character has Pneuma, a zone like the Parasites will be a piece of cake. ⬆️ Adventurer Agency This is the tab where you can find a leveling group ! You can register your group and automatically recruit new players; to do so, simply open the Adventurers Agency as follows: As a leader, you can therefore promote your group – just make sure you specify the area and channel where your team is based. If a member leaves the group, the shared experience will be reset and become individual; it’s up to you to manually set it back to shared, otherwise the group members who aren’t AFK are bound to complain. If you’re looking for a group, you can click on one; if it isn’t full, you’ll be added to it just a few seconds after clicking “Join Party”: ⬆️ Affixes Affixes are an essential part of the game; getting the piece of equipment with the best affixes for your class is the way to go in Zero. The list of affixes is available here . When an item with one or more affixes drops to the ground, it will be surrounded by a coloured halo corresponding to the number of affixes: blue for 1 yellow for 2 purple for 3 green for 4 (to be checked) Red for 5 (to be checked) Notes: Max HP is often prioritised to avoid dying too early HIT and FLEE are quite important for melee classes Max SP for classes that use skills Or Variable Casting Time for casters (mages and acolytes) Find below some Armors and Weapons dropped by specific monsters for the early game: ⬆️ Cash Shop Probably one of the lightest CS ever on Ragnarok (since CS exists...) nonetheless it is present even if we are running a subscription based model... and of course it gives some advantages: Exp/Drop Boosts Consummables Stats Boosts, HP/SP Regen Potions, Life Insurance, Death Penalty Reduction, Token... Gym Passes Permanent mount (but you cannot attack when mounted, it gives movement speed) Ores (7+ Refines Boxes) QoL items to be paid weekly or monthly (Portable Kafra/Tool Dealer) Hidden World Key to access Y and Z PvP channels Costumes (A lot...) Beginner Weapons/Armors The only way to consume it is to load credits aka Kafra Points through the Top-up services. ⬆️ Main Quest Throughout your adventure on Ragnarok Zero:Global, there’s a main quest (MQ) available which offers a change from the XP grind and also allows you to gain experience. Most of these are still ‘FedEx’-style quests, but they do provide a welcome break. There are level requirements, and you won’t be able to complete everything in one go (for example, level 20, level 40, etc.). The main quest continues as new patches are released. Note: During the open beta, doing all the main quest was representing 4 4 % at level 49. More details to come after the opening. ⬆️ Auto Hunt This is a feature that allows your character to hunt autonomously based on a whole host of parameters, which I won’t go into here but there is a very very nice guide made by Lys please have a look to it ! Slacker's Survival Guide by Lys Once auto-hunt has been set up, simply click on the twin swords so that they turn blue, indicating that auto-hunt is activated. Your character will then begin to explore the map according to your settings The Monsters section is reset between each map change, so if you decide to exclude any monsters, you’ll need to redo that selection only. You can configure a key to enable or disable the auto-hunt in the Game Settings. Auto Pot (AP) To be used during manual hunting; the settings for this auto-pot remain the same as those set in auto-hunt. Very useful when managing your HP/SP isn’t a priority. You can assign a key to toggle the mode on and off. Same as before, when activated the logo turns blue. ⬆️ Memorial Dungeon These are daily activities that you can make as a team and solo later. The nicest thing, I discovered was the fact that even if you disconnect or leave the instance for any reason, you can still enter it again as long as the instance is still open . Poring Village /navi pront_fild05 146/235 You’ll be battling waves of Porings, each ending with a boss; defeat all three bosses and you’ll receive your daily reward. Nothing really fancy and available starting level 30+. Leave the instance and destroy it to loot the chest: Rewards One for each day of the week and a box for the weekend days: Monday: Poring Jello Fragment Tuesday: Poporing Jello Fragment Wednesday: Drop Jello Fragment Thursday: Deviling Jello Fragment Friday: Angeling Jello Fragment Saturday/Sunday: Jellopy Fragment Box Why farming them? A multitude of fragments dropped on the floor all over the map and are probably lootable by anyone. The fragments can then be exchanged at the Raid Manager, Yakt standing in the Eden HQ. There is a daily quest and I advise anyone to participate in the PvE MvP Raids as much as you can ! ⬆️ Mission Board Apart from the Main Quest (MQ), I wouldn’t recommend doing the side quests, as they involve relatively interesting tasks but offer rewards that are only average at best (HP/SP potions). Having say that... If you don’t know what path to follow it is still a good way to start to walk on the different maps of the game. The consumables are overall good. ⬆️ Market Place Unlike many official servers, where the player shops are directly in Prontera or even Alberta (ah, the good old days ❤️), a dedicated area is available and can be accessed from the Kafra in Prontera: The area is divided into four zones, and you can travel quickly from one to another if you wish: The Kafra, a Blacksmith’s forge and a Tool Dealer are available, notably right in the center. This first step will allow you to return to Prontera. You can therefore set up a Vending or Buying post, whether or not you are a merchant class : You can search for specific item using the Vending Search Scroll (1) or the Deluxe Vending Search Scroll (2) : The research using these catalogs are care sensitive to be careful 😙 The only difference between the regular and deluxe catalogs are about finding shops. The latest one, the deluxe version, allows you to instantly buy the item without moving while using the regular one you will have find it yourself: Double click on the Shop Name, a white cross will appear on the minimap to give you a rough idea of the location and the shop will be highlighted. You can keep the catalog opened while walking and up to 5 searches can be done before to require another one. It is indeed possible to complete a quest that allows you to act as a seller or buyer whilst offline or whilst playing your character. Above level 40, if you want to reset either of these, it will cost you 1 Zelstar per additional level: if you are level 80, you will need 40 Zelstars. Note that several free resets should come to the server at major patches... could be the right time to test out things ! This is very effective in mobbing/DD roles, or simply in different parts of the game, such as in instances or PvP/WoE, for example! This action can be performed every 10 seconds. ⬆️ Earn Zenys First tip: make sure you have a Merchant with Discount and Overcharge set to 10 on your account; this will allow them to take items directly from the Kafra and sell them at a good price. Bear in mind that some items will likely be in high demand among players, and it’ll be more profitable to sell them to players rather than to NPCs. Lots of monsters drop Fly Wings ; you’ll probably end up with more than you need, but they sell very, very well to NPCs. As for loot in general, don’t hesitate to pick everything up, many items are very useful. Selling them to NPCs or other players will allow you to afford purchases such as HP/SP consumables or ammunition. Strawberries even sold at the NPC is a great source of income and it's easy to get on Snakes even at the lowest levels. While hunting snakes, what I like is that they also drop Red Herbs allowing your character to keep up with high HP very easily... Note: Strawberries are equivalent to 6 Cheeses, check what is working for you !
